messages:
Nina (Marketing): Idea: run a compact community "quickstart lab" next week focused on a reference app + a concise benchmark narrative. Deliverables: a 1-page tutorial, a short blog post, a 20-min webinar (demo + q), and a gated downloadable starter kit. Low effort, high value. Thoughts?
Omar (DevRel): I'm in. I'll scaffold a repo with a one-file tutorial and a tiny web UI that calls Redwood. Aim for local-first dev flow so people can fork quickly.
Felix (Eng): I can produce a minimal benchmark: cold vs warm cache and Hosted vs Dedicated cost sketch. Two charts: latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. I'll include the exact command used.
Rhea (Growth): For the CTA, recommend: "Starter kit + runnable refapp" gated for commercial interest, and open sample code for immediate clone. We'll push via community newsletter + OSS channels.
Maya (Design): I can design a landing with a GIF hero and 3 card screenshots. Need repo screenshots by Wed.
Nina (Marketing): Run-of-show idea: 3m intro, 10m live build (walkthrough + deploy), 4m bench highlights, 3m CTA + Qs. Omar, can you own run-of-show and produce a rehearsal checklist?
Omar (DevRel): Yes. Will add a rehearsal checklist to repo: mic check, demo data loaded, demo account keys, and recorded fallback.
Felix (Eng): Repro command for appendix:

```bash
# quick bench run
python perf/run_quick.py --model redwood-small --seq 128 --batch 2 --warmup 10 --sdk-version 0.13.0
```

Felix (Eng): Logging note: include GPU type, quant flags, SDK link, and exact request payload used for the benchmark.
Rhea (Growth): Messaging options: 1) "Quickly ship a responsive LLM UX", 2) "Prototype with production inference in mind", 3) "Starter kit for predictable LLM costs". Which do we prefer for community socials?
Nina (Marketing): Lean 1 for socials and 2 for blog. 3 is fine for gated kit messaging. We'll create UTMs per channel.
Maya (Design): Social assets list: 60s highlight clip, 20s GIF, two tweet cards. I can produce variants once Omar shares the GIF.
EventBot: Reminder: demo namespace reservation window Thu 2-5pm. Please request reservation 48h prior.
Omar (DevRel): I'll reserve Thu 2-3pm for the live run and do a dress rehearsal Wed. Repo deliverables: tutorial.md, demo.gif, run_of_show.md.
Felix (Eng): Deliverables: perf CSV, scripts, and two PNG charts by Tue EOD.
Rhea (Growth): I'll draft registration copy and a short email sequence (immediate download + 2 follow-ups). Nina, assign me a reviewer for tone.
Nina (Marketing): Assigning: Rhea -> Nina for copy review; Omar -> Maya for screenshots; Felix -> Nina for charts. Sync Friday for final asset check. :tada:
